name: Treffpunkt Pub
kurzbeschreibung:
**Meet at the Pub in Krimml** – your gateway to the heart of the **Tirol**’s wildest waterfalls and dramatic alpine landscapes.

Nestled in the **Zillertal Alps**, **Krimml** is where the **Krimml Waterfalls**—Europe’s highest—thunder down in breathtaking force. Whether you’re here for **hiking**, **rafting**, or simply soaking in the raw beauty of nature, the **Pub** is your cozy starting point.

After a day of adventure, unwind with a **Tiroler Gröstl**, a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, or a frothy **Schnaps** by the fire. The **Pub**’s rustic charm and warm hospitality make it the perfect spot to swap stories with fellow travelers—or just relax with a local **Bier** and a view of the **Krimmlbach** roaring by.

**Pro tip:** Ask about the best **Wanderwege** (hiking trails) or **Winteraktivitäten** (winter sports)—locals know the hidden gems!

**Plan your visit:**
📍 **Location:** Krimml, **Tirol**, Austria
🚗 **How to get there:** By car (via **Innsbruck** or **Salzburg**) or public transport (train to **St. Johann in Tirol**, then bus).
📅 **Best time to visit:** Year-round—summer for **Wanderungen**, winter for **Skifahren** and **Rodeln** in the nearby **Gerlosberg**.
